source: 本轮大型箱子 Lore 实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Replenish

lines.raw: §7Upon breaking crops, nether wart, or cocoa, automatically replant from materials in your inventory.
lines.text: Upon breaking crops, nether wart, or cocoa, automatically replant from materials in your inventory.
lines.gloss: 较短的旧措辞单独按完整句匹配,不把另一变体额外列举的野玫瑰、向日葵添入此原文。
lines.zh: 收获作物、下界疣或可可豆后,自动使用背包中的材料补种。
